inputs.drivers: Engagement and hours; creator supply; subscriptions and pricing; advertising yield; commerce; gaming and PC refresh; consumer-brand demand.
inputs.invalidation: Attention fragments, safety and regulatory costs rise, royalties or platform fees cap margins, or consumer demand and brand relevance fade.
inputs.seed_claim: Platforms and brands with durable engagement, creators, subscriptions, advertising, and recognisable IP may compound monetisation and margins, subject to safety, content economics, fashion cycles, and competition.
inputs.supporting_evidence: The seed requires engagement and monetisation to rise together, creator ecosystems to deepen, pricing to stick, and operating leverage to expand free cash flow.
inputs.value_chain: Social and video platforms; music and audio subscriptions; gaming and creator platforms; peripherals; consumer brands monetising digital attention.

objective: Research one digital-attention, gaming, and consumer-ecosystem investment idea.
